$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. An account at a website or online service, with the login to it. It starts from the website of the old profile; the online shop (address, phone, customer number) is not part of it. The passkey properties are one passkey; two backup flags of the KeePassXC passkey are not listed yet.
title: Online account
description: An account at a website or online service: where it is, how to log in, and the passkey for it.

UserName.description: The user name of the login.

email.description: The e-mail address registered with the account.

URL.description: The web address of the login. It should start with https (in any letter case); http:// is a valid address, so this is a hint and never an error.

Password.description: The password of the login. Empty for an account that has only a passkey.

otp.description: The one-time-password secret (TOTP or HOTP) of the login.

passkey_relying_party.description: The site the passkey belongs to, as a domain name (WebAuthn: relying party id).

passkey_username.description: The user name stored with the passkey.

passkey_user_handle.description: The user handle the site assigned to the passkey.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid. Empty means it does not expire.

allOf.description: An account has a password or a passkey.
A passkey has all four parts or none.
